app_store.name: Golden Moments
app_store.subtitle: Zviitwa zveAlzheimer
app_store.promotional_text: Zviitwa zvakareruka zvekufarira pamwe chete: makadhi makuru emifananidzo, mifananidzo yemhuri, pasina wachi kana mapoinzi. Une chiyeuchidzo chaunoisa. Hapana account.
app_store.description:
Tsvaga chiitwa chakareruka chekufarira pamwe chete. Golden Moments inopa kufananidza mifananidzo kwakapfava nekutarisa mifananidzo pamwe chete kumhuri nevanochengeta, kusanganisira vanoshandisa nguva nemunhu anogara nedementia kana chirwere cheAlzheimer.

TANGA NEZVIDUKU
Tanga nemakadhi mana makuru nemifananidzo yekutanga yakajairika. Chengeta mifananidzo ichioneka, kana kuivanza kana zvichinyaradza. Mutambo wakapfava hauna wachi, mapoinzi kana mutongo. Sarudza makadhi 4, 6, 8 kana 12 sezvaunowana.

ZVIVE ZVAKO
Sarudza mifananidzo yemhuri uchishandisa chisarudzi chemifananidzo chechishandiso chako. Golden Moments inochengeta makopi madiki ekushanda pachishandiso; haitsvaki muraibhurari yako uye haishandure mifananidzo yako yekwakatangira. Chengeta kusvika pamifananidzo 24 muunganidzwa mumwe.

TARISA PAMWE CHETE
Tarisa mufananidzo mumwe panguva imwe. Mibvunzo yekutaurirana inogona kushandiswa inokukurudzira kutaura pasina kukumbira munhu kurangarira mazita kana kupa mhinduro chaiyo. Kungotarisa kwakakwana.

PASINA INTERNET PANOPEDZA
Mifananidzo yekutanga inowanika pakarepo. Makopi emifananidzo yakatorwa anoshanda pasina internet mushure mekutorwa. Kusarudza mifananidzo yekwakatangira yakachengetwa muiCloud chete kunogona kuda internet. Mapakeji ese masere emifananidzo ari mu app, pasina kutorwa kwemifananidzo yakasiyana.

HAPANA ACCOUNT KANA SEVHA YEMIFANANIDZO
Makopi emifananidzo yemhuri anogara mu app pachishandiso ichi. Unogona kubvisa makopi pasina kubvisa mifananidzo yekwakatangira. Kuchengetedza kwechishandiso kunogona kuisa data yeapp. Shanduro iyi haigoveri mifananidzo pakati pehama.

Golden Moments ndeyevaraidzo nekutaurirana pamwe chete. Haiongorori, hairipi, haidziviriri, uye haiyeri chirwere chedementia kana chirwere cheAlzheimer. Zviitwa hazvikodzeri vese; teerera zvinofarirwa nemunhu nekunyaradzwa kwake, uye mira kana kuchinja chiitwa kana zvichidikanwa.
app_store.release_notes: Mapeji akajeka ekutamba pamwe chete. Mutambo wekutanga unoparadzanisa peya yega yega. Mamwe mapeji anokodzera zviri nani nemashoko makuru, uye mashoko anoteedzera saizi yefoni kusvika kakapetwa kaviri. Tarisa pamwe chete haachaverengi mifananidzo. Pa“Chii chakaoma nhasi?”, nhamba dzerubatsiro dzakanyorwa seeU.S., nechiziviso chekushandisa nhamba yepanzvimbo kune dzimwe nyika. Matauriro akagadzirwa nemuchina, haasati atariswa. Kana chimwe chisina kunaka, titaurire kubva muRubatsiro nekuvanzika.
